name: Chaos Reigns
summary: Every night we delay, another villager falls to a vice. Each of them heard a three-eyed beast whispering.

stages.journal: A villager confessed, and said a three-eyed thing whispered to them.
stages.hint: Hear the others out before the village falls apart.
Hear the rest, and then go north.

stages.journal: We heard them all and know what the beast promises.
The village has gone to bedlam: shops shut and doors barred.
